scenario.name: r-cd-model-token
scenario.description: continue_delegate bracket/token form parses and forwards model=<provider/model> to the delegate child.
scenario.notes: Requires a seat/session surface where final bracket text is scanned; message-body seats remain PARTIAL by declared seat class.
scenario.registryNotes: Runnable local conversion: lightContext subagent emits terminal [[CONTINUE_DELEGATE: ... | model=<alias>]] bracket; delegated child returns nonce and requested model byte.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the parent request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate for this model row

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-correlated delegate child session/run is observed on the subscribed session stream or session history

expectedReceipts.name: child-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Token delegate child SERVED provider/model from the row-bound assistant message in the child's own chat.history inside the row run window (after the row anchor, first message carrying the row sentinel; stopReason recorded). sessions.describe model/modelProvider is recorded separately as the persisted SELECTION and alone yields PARTIAL (selection matched; served route unproven). Active fallback or a mixed served window is FAIL (#561/#562 review).

expectedReceipts.name: return-payload
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return includes the row nonce and observed model/provider summary

expectedReceipts.name: trace-or-session-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id, span tree, or session-event correlation tying dispatch to child and return

expectedReceipts.name: bracket-parse-origin
expectedReceipts.description: Journal/session evidence that the delegate originated from bracket-token parsing with model modifier present

expectedReceipts.name: bracket-model-modifier
expectedReceipts.description: Observed terminal bracket included model=<requested> modifier before scan/strip

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON (tempo-trace-<id>.json) for the continue_delegate tool → continuation.delegate.dispatch → continuation.delegate.fire topology, collected by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. Required for every continuation row (#600).

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: continuation-trace-correlation.json: exactly one Tempo trace matched by the row’s reason hash, length, and delegate mode, holding one continuation.delegate.dispatch span, one continuation.delegate.fire span, and the originating continue_delegate tool span on one trace and chain.

review.notes: PASS-candidate only when bracket parse origin, requested model, and observed child model all match. Declare seat-class before firing; do not retro-justify scanner suppression.

census.limits: The census found accepted continuation entry spans carry no origin, session, turn, or run identity and that proof traffic carries no marker, so this row’s trace receipt joins the continue_delegate tool span to continuation.delegate.dispatch and continuation.delegate.fire only by shared trace, causal timing, and the reason fingerprint and mode. The scenario records the fingerprint of the bracket's delegate task, which collect-continuation-trace.mjs matches in run and from public evidence afterwards; invocation.originSurface raw-final-text tells it the trace holds no typed continue_delegate tool span. The census also found bracket origin has no positive span attribute, so the trace cannot prove the delegate came from the token.

spans.name: continuation.delegate.dispatch
spans.notes: Accepted entry span. Carries no origin/session/turn/run identity.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed continue_delegate evidence. Joined to the dispatch span only by shared trace and causal timing.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and asserted by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: Model and provider identifiers are published literally because they are public product identifiers. The bracket text, final reply text, raw nonces, raw session keys, and tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: The terminal bracket carries model=<requested>, the delegate originates from bracket parsing, and the child’s served model in its own transcript equals the requested model.
controls.negative: A message-body surface cannot prove the row and stays PARTIAL, and a child that inherits the seat default fails.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded or empty Tempo answer leaves tempo-trace-json and its correlation receipt pending. That is review debt, not evidence that the continuation did not happen, and it never changes the VU verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: Bracket parse origin, the model modifier, and the child’s run-window-bound served model all match the request. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: A message-body or unknown surface, an unset or alias requested model, only the persisted selection matched, or a required receipt is missing. Missing traces keep the row review-pending without changing its class.
verdictAuthority.fail: The child serves a different model than requested, including silent inheritance of the seat default.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cd-model-token.js drives a terminal bracket from a lightContext child and reads the token delegate’s transcript.
execution.manual: Seat class must be declared before firing; manual scanner reasoning is never evidence.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row owns the verdict. The Tempo trace receipts decide only whether review is complete; manual review corroborates topology and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Bracket-token model override row. Use lightContext subagent/raw final text so scanner sees terminal bracket; message-body surfaces remain PARTIAL. PASS requires bracket origin + model modifier + delegate return with requested model byte.
